steps.step: re-apply after rollback matches first apply

deviations: Read grant not scripted as a file, as in MOD-002: the reporting role's name is not recorded in the repo, and the Developer tools cannot write a standalone grant script. Assumption: the grant goes in the notes for a human to run, with a placeholder role name: GRANT SELECT ON Layercake.vw_contact_payment_reconciliation TO [<reporting_role>]; where <reporting_role> is the role the reporting tool already uses to read Layercake. Readers rely on the dbo ownership chain to synapse_fo.CUSTTRANS and CE.tblContact_Test_Records (DES-001 security).
New view uses upper-case keywords (base standard), as the MOD-001 and MOD-002 objects do; no project keyword-case override is recorded.
notes:
Object: Layercake.vw_contact_payment_reconciliation (new). It aggregates each side per legal entity, then FULL OUTER JOINs them so an entity on one side only still shows, with the other side 0.
- FO side: read directly from synapse_fo.CUSTTRANS with TRANSTYPE 15, cancelled payments kept. Test accounts are excluded with NOT EXISTS against CE.tblContact_Test_Records, so a NULL apuk_contactnumber does not drop rows and duplicate test records do not multiply them. Rows with a NULL ACCOUNTNUM are counted. The total is -1 * SUM(AMOUNTMST).
- Dataset side: read from Layercake.fact_contact_payment.
- Totals are decimal(38,6) and compared exactly, with no rounding (Q-023). SUM ignores NULL amounts, so an entity whose amounts are all NULL shows 0 on that side.
- is_reconciled is 1 only when both counts and both totals are equal.
- Every column is NOT NULL, as designed: ISNULL is the outermost expression.
- Under the case-insensitive collation, legal entities that differ only in case are grouped and joined as one entity, which matches the table's primary key.

Tests: the Tester's suite went from 0 of 10 passing (the view did not exist) to 10 of 10. Dev unit tests (3): all-NULL amounts reconcile at 0; an entity with only out-of-scope FO rows does not appear; every view column is reported NOT NULL. Round-trip passes and the checks pass. The sqlfluff findings are advisory, mostly identifier case on the FO upper-case columns.

Grant for a human to run once the role name is confirmed: GRANT SELECT ON Layercake.vw_contact_payment_reconciliation TO [<reporting_role>];

Performance: the view reads FO directly and is meant for occasional checks (DES-001 performance).

Test-first: the first run had 0 of 10 of the Tester's tests passing; the final run passed 10 of 10 and 3 unit test(s), in 3 run(s).
